race.comment: COSMIC FIRE (7) sets up well fourth-up and down in the weights. Has proven versatile with her speed and maps to blend in at just the right time. Has been freshened with a month between runs and can give this a big shake. EPIC PROPORTIONS (2) has mixed his form since joining the QLD ranks but boasts strong peaks. Maloney reuniting is a bonus. BRAVE MONARCH (1) is a talented gelding resuming for the Munce camp. Faces quite the task from barrier 15 under 60kg but has plenty of X-factor. Not writing off. BLAZING HARRY (11) rises sharply from Benchmark grade but gets in a treat at the weights and is in red-hot touch. Thompson's booking signals confidence. LET'SFACETHEMUSIC (8) is as consistent as they come and boasts strong form references. Is sure to put his best foot forward again.
